profile.headline: Web Developer at Cape
profile.summary: Software engineer with a strong focus on frontend with over 3 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying innovative, high-performing software solutions. Hands-on and focused on working with diverse teams of engineers to drive the delivery of high-quality, user-centric applications while continuously identifying and capitalizing on new opportunities to optimize performance and the user experience.

positions.title: Web Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained Storyblok-powered pages and reusable UI components, collaborating with Marketing, Growth, and Design to ship brand-consistent layouts and flexible, campaign-ready components using React, TypeScript, and SCSS.
• Collaborated closely with designers to translate Figma designs into scalable, accessible components.
• Implemented llms.txt across the website to improve how Rho’s content is indexed, interpreted, and surfaced by AI models, partnering with Growth to ensure accurate brand representation.
• Improved sitewide SEO visibility from 63% to 97% by conducting technical audits in Semrush, resolving indexing and canonical issues, improving metadata, and reducing content duplication.
• Ensured strong crawlability and performance by leveraging CSS Modules and SCSS and keeping JavaScript usage lightweight for search-friendly markup.
• Partnered cross-functionally with Marketing, Growth, and Design to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and resolved web-related tickets to unblock launches and maintain site stability.

positions.title: Junior Product Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with product and design teams to deliver new products and features on time, providing hands-on technical support to troubleshoot issues, resolve UI and data-related bugs, and document feature requests to keep development workflows moving.
• Developed and maintained responsive, visually engaging UIs for 11 brands and an internal one-stop-shop Deal Desk app used by 250+ users to track sales deals and optimize media using React, JavaScript/Typescript, and CSS.
• Built custom, reusable card components for BDG’s proprietary Typeset CMS to support diverse content team requirements across all brand sites, ensuring seamless integration, design consistency, and ease of use for editors.
• Implemented background and recurring job functionalities for proprietary Deal Desk web application to enable the efficient exporting of large commissioned sales datasets, automate outdated record deletion, and optimize database performance using Solid Queue.
• Designed and launched email newsletters with 100K unique opens per send using HTML and CSS, driving advertising revenue and ensuring cross-platform compatibility through Litmus testing  across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
